items.title: Josh Giddey averaged 2.28 bad-pass turnovers in 32.1 minutes last season.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
Josh Giddey averaged 2.28 bad-pass turnovers in 32.1 minutes last season.

This season, he's averaging 2.38 in 28.1 minutes.

That's a 20% increase per 36 minutes, despite a reduced offensive workload.

My concern is less about ballhandling than decision-making.
